title: 40 Zombies vs One Steel Shutter (3D cut)

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Forty zombies are leaning on the only door you have.
lines.tts: [urgent, low] Forty zombies are leaning on the only door you have.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: And the steel is starting to bend.
lines.tts: [tense] And the steel is starting to bend.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: It's 3:07 a.m. You're alone on the night shift at a highway gas station.
lines.tts: [calm, low] It's three oh seven A M. You're alone on the night shift at a highway gas station.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: The door chime rings... and whatever walks in is not here for gas.
lines.tts: [ominous] The door chime rings... and whatever walks in is not here for gas.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You slam the lockdown button. Steel shutters crash down.
lines.tts: [urgent] You slam the lockdown button. Steel shutters crash down.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day seven. A car alarm screams in the parking lot.
lines.tts: [tense] Day seven. A car alarm screams in the parking lot.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: By sunrise, forty of them are pressed against your shutter.
lines.tts: [ominous] By sunrise, forty of them are pressed against your shutter.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Six thousand pounds on one sheet of steel. One bolt pops. Then another.
lines.tts: [tense] Six thousand pounds on one sheet of steel. One bolt pops. Then another.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Most people panic. They scream. They run.
lines.tts: [fast] Most people panic. They scream. They run.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You do the opposite. Shoes off. Lights off. You crawl behind the counter... and you don't move. For eleven hours.
lines.tts: [calm, low] You do the opposite. Shoes off. Lights off. You crawl behind the counter... and you don't move. For eleven hours.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You see, they don't hunt with their eyes. They hunt by sound. And forty of them can't find what they can't hear.
lines.tts: [low, intrigued] You see, they don't hunt with their eyes. They hunt by sound. And forty of them can't find what they can't hear.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: By nightfall, they drift away... one by one.
lines.tts: [quiet] By nightfall, they drift away... one by one.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Then, on the night of Day 12... someone knocks.
lines.tts: [whispers] Then, on the night of day twelve... someone knocks.
